title: Microbial DNA Extraction from Seawater Filters and 16S rRNA Gene Sequencing
author: Emma Rocke
materials: Thaw filters on ice briefly just before extraction.

steps.title: Collect Seawater Samples
steps.instruction: Collect 5 L of seawater per sample into clean, labeled carboys or bottles.

substeps.instruction: Keep samples shaded and cool (on ice or in a cooler) until filtration.
Aim to filter within 24 hours of collection.

steps.title: Pre-filter Seawater
steps.instruction: Remove large particles and debris using a 200 µm mesh pre-filter.

substeps.instruction: Assemble a 200 µm mesh pre-filter on the filtration apparatus.
Gently pre-filter each 5 L seawater sample through the mesh.
Discard the retained material and collect the pre-filtered seawater in a clean reservoir.

steps.title: Filter Seawater for Microbial Capture
steps.instruction: Filter the pre-filtered seawater through a 0.2 µm polycarbonate membrane filter using vacuum or peristaltic pumping.

substeps.instruction: Mount a 0.2 µm polycarbonate membrane filter in a sterile filter holder.
Filter up to 5 L of seawater, adjusting flow to avoid clogging.
If the filter clogs before 5 L is processed, record the final filtered volume in metadata and use additional filters if necessary.

steps.title: Harvest and Store Filters
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the filter with sterile forceps, fold it (cell side inwards), and place it into a labeled sterile microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Immediately freeze filters at −20°C (or preferably −80°C) until DNA extraction.

steps.title: Perform DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using the E.Z.N.A. Water DNA protocol.

substeps.instruction: In a clean area, use sterile scissors or a scalpel to cut each filter into small pieces inside a compatible microcentrifuge tube.
Add the appropriate lysis buffer (e.g., Buffer MBL or equivalent) as per manufacturer’s instructions.
Vortex thoroughly to ensure filter pieces are fully immersed.
Incubate for lysis (typically 65°C for 10–30 min, depending on kit version).
Add binding buffer and ethanol as specified.
Transfer lysate to the HiBind® DNA spin column, centrifuge, and discard flow-through.
Perform all wash steps with the kit wash buffers.
Dry the column by an additional centrifugation step to remove residual ethanol.
Elute DNA with 50–100 µL of pre-warmed elution buffer (or nuclease-free water) directly onto the membrane, incubate for ≈2–5 min, then centrifuge.
Optionally perform a second elution for higher total yield (note: this lowers concentration).

steps.title: Store and Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Store extracted DNA at −20°C and measure concentration using a Qubit 4 Fluorometer.

substeps.instruction: Use the dsDNA Broad Range (BR) kit for quantification.
For low-yield samples, switch to the Qubit dsDNA High Sensitivity (HS) kit.

steps.title: Clean and Concentrate DNA (Optional)
steps.instruction: If DNA concentration is too low or inhibitors are suspected, clean and concentrate the DNA using a column-based kit (e.g., Zymo Research DNA Clean & Concentrator-5).

substeps.instruction: Elute in a small volume (e.g., 10–20 µL) to increase concentration.
Re-quantify with Qubit.

steps.title: Prepare 16S rRNA Gene Libraries
steps.instruction: Prepare full-length 16S rRNA gene libraries using the Oxford Nanopore 16S Barcoding Kit 1–24 (SQK-16S024) and a high-fidelity Taq master mix (e.g., Q5® High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix).

substeps.instruction: Thaw DNA on ice and dilute or concentrate to approximately 50 ng in 10 µL per reaction.
Assemble the following on ice: 12.5 µL high-fidelity Taq master mix, 2.5 µL ONT 16S primer/barcode mix, and 10 µL template DNA (~50 ng).
Run PCR with the following program: 95°C for 1 min; 37 cycles of (95°C for 20 s, 55°C for 30 s, 72°C for 2 min); final extension at 72°C for 5 min.

steps.title: Purify and Normalize Amplicons
steps.instruction: Clean PCR products using a bead-based protocol (e.g., Mag-Bind® TotalPure NGS or AMPure® XP) at a 0.8–1.0× bead ratio.

substeps.instruction: Elute purified amplicons in 10–20 µL of low-EDTA buffer or nuclease-free water.
Quantify cleaned amplicons with Qubit (BR or HS).
Normalize and pool up to 24 barcoded libraries equimolarly to a final total DNA amount of 50–80 ng per sequencing run.

steps.title: Sequence on MinION
steps.instruction: Prepare the pooled library for loading on a MinION flow cell (R9.4.1) following the SQK-16S024 protocol.

substeps.instruction: Load the prepared library onto an R9.4.1 flow cell on a MinION Mk1B or Mk1C device.
Run the sequencing experiment for approximately 16 hours, monitoring pore health and yield via MinKNOW.
Perform basecalling and demultiplexing as per ONT recommendations for 16S barcoded libraries.
